mapper.sql: id, name, postal_code, address, phone, email, license_number, business_hours, closed_days, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM companies
WHERE 1 = 1
AND name LIKE CONCAT( '%', REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( TRIM(#{query.keyword}), '=', '==' ), '%', '=%' ), '_', '=_' ), '%' ) ESCAPE '='
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT
FROM companies WHERE id = #{companyId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies ( name, postal_code, address, phone, email, license_number, business_hours, closed_days, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{company.name}, #{company.postalCode}, #{company.address}, #{company.phone}, #{company.email}, #{company.licenseNumber}, #{company.businessHours}, #{company.closedDays}, 1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )

INSERT INTO rental_index_sync_tasks ( rental_id, retry_count, next_attempt_at, last_error ) SELECT r.id, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), NULL
FROM rentals r
WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} OR r.management_company_id = #{companyId}
ORDER BY r.id
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retry_count = 0, next_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), last_error = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
